campaign: Integrated validation, phase 2: bounded capability gains and evidence-gated simplification
doctrine:
Owner-directed replanning on 2026-09-04: validate the existing integrated capabilities before simplification, preserving the capability freeze enforced by structure. docs/plan.json is the sole live execution plan. Retain open row identities and gated historical completion references. No new model family, workflow, optimizer or general orchestration framework is admitted. Limit construction to reproduced defects, missing acceptance in existing owners, regression protection and evidence-backed simplification. The operator explicitly resumed implementation on 2026-09-04: gate this revision first, then execute ready steps through the existing dispatcher. This instruction supersedes the earlier user-stop; future operator stops still take precedence.

Document order ranks ready work; depends_on is the authority for prerequisites. Publish current-surface long-form admission records and run remaining benchmark and modality evidence now, without waiting for unrelated fixes or simplification. Preserve current-surface evidence as the before picture. Incorrect or unavailable capabilities remain explicit gaps, not passing evidence. A demonstrated defect blocks only affected claims. On an explicit resume, independent work may overlap through existing conflict-checked worktree/resource leases; shared files and exclusive GPU timing require resource coordination, not artificial capability dependencies. One writer owns a plan edit and gates it before any dispatch.

The existing long-form record already binds corpus-at-commit, floors, model and inference surface. Extend only the missing cross-revision guarantees: identical corpus/token inputs and explicit accepted baseline IDs, plus bounded cancellation in the existing longform command. These additions gate regression-baseline acceptance, not existing benchmark admission or modality runs. Raw instruction-model NLL alone is not an accuracy defect; preserve the observed chat ranking, add the chat-shaped rung and use matched-checkpoint references for published comparisons. Diagnostic regressions must not become accepted baselines.

Retain existing parity tests, longform tests and report checks as useful lower bounds. Before implementing or measuring a dispatched row, use plan -setverify to add its missing quantitative, coverage or runtime assertion to those checks; never replace useful checks with blanket exit-1 placeholders. New fixtures name an exact test and require its file; absent, skipped or zero-matching tests cannot pass. A build or successful listing alone does not establish capability, and report freshness is only a freshness check. Every acceptance names its model/task/case denominator, protocols, evidence identities, thresholds and exclusions. Extend the existing command/test owner only where an assertion is missing. UNAVAILABLE stays visible with a finding/disposition and is never successful capability evidence.

Use scoped host/kernel tests while fixing, a small recipe-derived execution-coverage set for each execution change, then full final verification of invalidated capabilities. Coverage includes operator path, weight type, head geometry, cache policy and modality; one model per weight type is insufficient. Publish a small accepted immutable guard baseline and enforce the regression gate before execution changes. It depends on the minimal stable-input contract, not modalities or the defects it guards. Expand and re-accept the full catalog after fixes and modality evidence; preserve original records and refuse to normalize known failures. All simplification follows the initial modality report and small-model benchmark pass. Compare quality, throughput and peak/retained memory on identical inputs with declared reference bounds and repeated isolated timing; no aggregate gain hides a required regression. Reuse exact unaffected evidence with recorded independence, rerunning only invalidated slices.

Every evaluate pass carries an explicit measured -budget. Run small models first; the full 27B MMLU-Pro pass is operator-launched with -budget 3h and must not be started by another row. Keep all 12032 cases and both protocols; incomplete bounded runs remain incomplete. MATH is excluded. Publish evidence only from a clean worktree after implementation lands. Gates read exact accepted evidence for long campaigns rather than launching hours of publication. Store paths resolve the intended canonical store under OVERGO_DATA_ROOT. Extend longform's missing aggregate budget before its full regression-baseline campaign; existing per-rung admission remains usable now.

Reproduce findings through cmd/finding with affected claims. Correctness, security, data-loss or invalid-measurement defects interrupt affected work and receive explicit prerequisites; independent validation continues. Preserve historical evidence and checkpoint content identities. Relocation must verify the destination and rollback before retiring the original. Simplification must remove measured maintenance cost while preserving capability. Closeout joins every terminal branch, includes post-change modality revalidation where affected, and cannot clear an explicit user stop.

Optimize capability per wall-hour by simplifying existing implementation: remove redundant transfers, copies, cache ownership, branching and duplicate numerical paths before adding mechanisms. Rank admitted changes by measured throughput/memory/reliability gain or recurring maintenance cost removed. Each slice identifies before evidence, behavior retained, mechanism deleted and executable counterexample. Prefer existing generic owners and one derived policy; no extra controllers, compatibility wrappers or parallel report formats. File splitting and command-count reductions alone are not capability gains. Keep unrelated validation off each slice and reuse exact unaffected evidence.

items.title: Make measurements repeatable and failures actionable

steps.title: Bind stable comparison inputs, accepted baseline references and longform cancellation
steps.rationale: Reuse existing long-form corpus-at-commit, model/surface identity, declared floors and runrecord contracts. Add only cross-revision corpus/token equality and explicit accepted baseline references instead of latest-other-surface selection, and per-model/aggregate cancellation in cmd/longform. Reject changed inputs, self-comparison, missing rungs and an unaccepted/degraded baseline; cancellation preserves completed evidence and reports unfinished coverage. The named fixture exercises these refusals. This row supports regression-baseline acceptance and does not gate current-surface long-form admission, existing benchmark passes or modality checks.

steps.title: Preserve bounded diagnostics for failed and timed-out test lanes
steps.rationale: The repository review saw test-lane report a gate-package failure without its diagnostic. Retain a bounded per-failure output tail, timeout/panic reason and named failing test in cmd/test-lane using existing testevidence parsing. Do not buffer an unbounded transcript or hide missing evidence. Reproduce failed tests, package timeout, malformed output and successful completion in the named hermetic test. This host-only work can overlap GPU work.

items.title: Publish an accepted, immutable baseline before simplification

steps.title: Publish a small accepted guard baseline before execution changes
steps.verify: go test ./internal/longform -count=1 && test -f cmd/longform/accepted_baseline_test.go && go test ./cmd/longform -run '^TestAcceptedBaselineEvidence$' -count=1
steps.rationale: Publish the smallest recipe-derived execution coverage set needed to guard upcoming Qwen/E4B decode and memory changes, with explicit accepted record IDs and stable corpus/token/model/recipe identities. Cover required short/long and cache-boundary rungs, correctness/output and quality floors, rates and retained bytes. Preserve known throughput loss and memory growth as defect targets, never accepted normal behavior. Missing chat and modality evidence remain visible gaps outside this small guard, not prerequisites. The accepted-baseline fixture rejects self-selection, known-bad baselines, changed inputs and missing required evidence. Bind read-only assertions over actual published records before closure. Expand the baseline later without overwriting these original records.

steps.title: Expand and re-accept the full baseline before broad simplification
steps.verify: go test ./internal/longform -count=1 && test -f cmd/longform/accepted_baseline_test.go && go test ./cmd/longform -run '^TestAcceptedBaselineEvidence$' -count=1
steps.rationale: After guarded defect fixes, the chat rung and initial modality evidence, expand the accepted baseline to the available full text catalog, both prompt shapes, required contexts, rates and peak/retained memory under explicit budgets. Preserve unavailable/failed dimensions with dispositions. Compare to initial guard and pre-fix evidence under identical inputs and declared bounds; pin accepted record IDs. Bind the actual catalog denominator and read-only completeness/non-regression assertion through longform before closure. Preserve historical records.

items.title: Enforce cheap execution-coverage regression checks before device-wide work

steps.title: Enforce cheap execution-coverage regression checks before device-wide work
steps.rationale: Use the code/kernel manifest and typed recipe/operator facts to select a small deterministic model set covering affected weight types, operator paths, head geometry, attention/cache policy and modality; weight type alone is insufficient. Minimize measured run cost subject to coverage, and widen scope when independence is unproven. Compare against the accepted immutable baseline. Sequence the quick model check before broader device work under an exclusive timing lease; host-only changes are explicitly inapplicable. Keep structure-budget checking in the cheap gate phase. Negative tests must reject a missing coverage class, stale/mismatched baseline, untested device path and a reproduced throughput/memory/quality regression. Bind an integration assertion proving the real gate selection and rejection path, alongside the host selector tests; use existing CI/protection ownership to prevent required device evidence being replaced by manual-workflow assumptions. Land the small guard before independent execution fixes; do not wait for media-report or full-catalog expansion. Widen accepted references when the full baseline lands.

items.title: Complete current-surface benchmarks and matched comparisons

steps.title: Complete MMLU-Pro for the smaller text models under both protocols
steps.rationale: Retain the completed DNA-pass and long-form-verification authority. First republish only missing/stale passing long-form admission records at the current inference surface, then run the missing fp8/small-model suite records immediately. No future refactor, memory optimization or measurement-contract implementation is a prerequisite. Query committed suite coverage and run only missing or invalidated model/protocol/case records on the current landed execution surface. Preserve the full 12032-case MMLU-Pro denominator and both declared protocols; exclude the 27B from this step and keep MATH excluded. Use measured cost and explicit evaluate -budget for bounded batches, smallest first. Acceptance asserts expected cases, distinct cases, protocol, model/recipe/data/code identities and completed outcomes; a regenerated report with missing cells does not pass. Dispatch contract: retain the current verifier as a lower bound, but bind executable assertions for the exact required denominator, identities, protocols, thresholds and outcomes described above before work starts. If missing, add the smallest read-only assertion to the existing owner and prove its failing counterexample before publishing evidence. A bare freshness/listing/lane command cannot close this row.

steps.title: Publish benchmark results with matched references and complete coverage
steps.rationale: Compare all required suite/model/protocol cells with declared references and local lm-eval oracle records. Compare as equivalent only when checkpoint/precision, dataset split/cases, shot count, template, scoring/generation protocol and answer extraction agree; otherwise label the protocol difference, not a performance regression. Preserve the known 100-case MMLU subset label rather than implying full MMLU coverage. Check all campaign-required suites, including prior BBH/MuSR/IFEval/DNA evidence for reuse validity; rerun only invalidated slices. Generate BENCHMARK.md after coverage and outcome assertions. For Gemma same-checkpoint comparisons, build the Gemma-capable llama.cpp revision when required and pin it with precision/template/protocol; missing reference evidence is a labeled comparison gap, not a prerequisite for the regression baseline. Dispatch contract: retain the current verifier as a lower bound, but bind executable assertions for the exact required denominator, identities, protocols, thresholds and outcomes described above before work starts. If missing, add the smallest read-only assertion to the existing owner and prove its failing counterexample before publishing evidence. A bare freshness/listing/lane command cannot close this row.

items.title: Close the two execution-boundary defects found in review

steps.title: Reject cross-site server mutations in credential-less local mode
steps.rationale: Reproduce the reviewed cross-site text/plain POST to /lora-adapters changing a scale without credentials. Enforce browser-origin protection and the JSON media-type contract at the shared request boundary, including local Host validation where necessary. Preserve intentional same-origin workbench requests and authenticated API use; test spoofed/local Host, cross-site Origin/Fetch Metadata, missing/invalid credentials, rejected requests causing no mutation, and allowed requests. Use the named regression fixture plus the existing route tests.

steps.title: Bound argv stdout during collection and terminate overflowed process trees
steps.rationale: Reproduce output exceeding artifact.MaxContentBytes before process exit. Replace the unbounded buffer at the argv transport with a bounded collector; overflow cancels the supervised process tree, drains/closes pipes safely and returns a typed failure rather than success or a partial JSON result. Test a finite flood and a continuing writer under a short fixture deadline, bounded retained bytes, descendant termination and failure receipt propagation; retain valid UTF-8/JSON behavior. Add the named fixture to agenttool and reuse processcontrol lifecycle tests.

steps.title: Generate the complete modality report from verified outcomes and visible gaps

items.title: Bound retained device memory across changing context capacities

steps.title: Bound retained device memory across changing context capacities
steps.rationale: The E4B ladder reportedly grew from 14 GB loaded to 39 GB after rung 32768. Treat graph executables, runner caches and pool free lists as hypotheses; instrument their live/retained byte accounting before changing ownership. Bind a failing repeated grow-shrink-grow context sequence in one long-lived runner/server. After warmup, retained allocation must stay within an explicit byte budget derived from model, maximum live cache, workspace, pool and graph allowances, without cumulative per-cycle growth. Cancellation, errors, release and reload must recover resources; synchronize before comparing counters. Accept with E4B runtime evidence plus host/device ownership tests and unchanged reference outputs, not a report-parser unit test. Prefer deleting redundant retention and establishing one existing lifetime owner over adding another cache manager or eviction knob.

items.title: Recover small-head decode throughput without losing long-context correctness

steps.title: Recover small-head decode throughput without losing long-context correctness
steps.rationale: The reviewed short-context Qwen2.5-0.5B rate fell from 295 to 139 tokens/s while E4B remained within about three percent. First remove capacity-sized host upload from BenchmarkDecodeAttention's timed iteration and keep caches resident; measure allocation/upload separately. Run the actual benchmark with -bench '^BenchmarkDecodeAttention$' and device opt-in, not only -run. Compare repeated isolated before/after runs across short contexts, 4096 boundaries, tile boundaries, long contexts and representative head geometries. Keep split-key correctness, NLL and memory guarantees; recover the measured short-context gap within predeclared noise bounds without trading away larger-context throughput. Bind both kernel parity and end-to-end Qwen/E4B assertions. Remove capacity-wide work and redundant transfers before introducing another dispatch policy; retain one shared path wherever parity permits.

items.title: Add the chat-shaped long-form rung for the Gemma 12B twins

steps.title: Add the chat-shaped long-form rung for the Gemma 12B twins
steps.rationale: Preserve the measured raw NLLs (6.94 and 6.97 for the 12B twins versus E4B 4.21) and the existing finding that instruction framing explains the raw ranking while chat scores rank correctly. Extend longform with the declared chat template, thinking disabled, 256 greedy output tokens, chat continuation NLL, text/token IDs, distinct 4-gram/repeated-span diagnostics and rates. Retain raw continuation alongside chat. Verify both precision variants and the small control. A Gemma-capable llama.cpp reference belongs to published-comparison, not this rung or baseline admission unless new same-checkpoint evidence establishes a runtime defect.

items.title: Run independent host recovery drills before closing reliability claims

steps.title: Provide the missing typed rollout-plan authoring path
steps.rationale: Address finding c9c88020 through recipe rollout-plan using the existing committed rollout contract: baseline, candidate, admission/cohort evidence and rollback authority. Derive cohort share/observation requirements from evidence. Test the CLI-to-store round trip and invalid authority refusal, not only parsing the document. Host-only; no dependency on benchmark or media completion.

steps.title: Exercise rollback, quarantine, peer failures and durable workflow recovery
steps.rationale: Use scratch stores/peers to exercise escalation, candidate quarantine and evidence-bound re-entry, exact predecessor rollback, peer timeout/partial response and workflow restart with persistent obligations. Inject failure before and after side effects/receipt publication; assert state, lineage, idempotence and absence of duplicate mutations. Bind executable drill tests using existing loop/agent-loop owners. A successful build is not a recovery result.

steps.title: Interrupt and recover the gate in a scratch clone
steps.rationale: Run the existing recover-preparation, recover-interrupted and watchdog paths against an isolated scratch clone/store. Assert exact source/index/HEAD, plan step and durable receipt state after interruptions at transaction boundaries; prohibit duplicate commit/advance. Capture bounded diagnostics and classify timeout explicitly. This host-only drill can run independently of model benchmarks, but must not contend with production gate/store locks.

items.title: Unify measured prefill policy where reference parity permits

steps.title: Unify measured prefill policy where reference parity permits
steps.rationale: Derive one policy from weight representation, column count and committed parity/cost evidence. Preserve a precise staging path wherever f16 conversion cannot meet the required bound; do not predetermine deletion of exact F32 staging outside proven coverage. Remove per-type duplication where behavior is equivalent. Measure the fp8 12B prompt-rate gap (1646 versus its bf16 twin's 2850 in prior evidence) on identical inputs/environment, without assuming the precision variants must have identical cost. Accept kernel parity, scoped model regression and before/after prompt-rate/memory curves; expand to the full text catalog at the following milestone.

items.title: Remove costly execution duplication behind the regression gate

steps.title: Remove costly execution duplication behind the regression gate
steps.rationale: The committed duplicate-excess ceiling is 9964; 9963 is its first strictly lower integer, not permission to grow to the stale 10012. Select a real duplicated CUDA/inference mechanism by measured cost, bind its removal and the resulting lower ceiling before implementation, and lower docs/clone_baseline.json through clone-census -update-baseline after verification. Preserve affected kernel/model behavior against the accepted baseline. Remove redundant ownership, wrappers or policy; arbitrary file splits do not qualify. Retire the executor size exception only through cohesive simplification with lower measured cost. Every slice passes scoped regression; final full validation follows.

items.title: Consolidate measured command duplication after validation consumers finish

steps.title: Consolidate measured command duplication after validation consumers finish
steps.rationale: Inventory actual overlapping wrappers rather than assume a fixed command count. Fold probe/lane/parity entrypoints into typed subcommands only where ownership/maintenance cost falls; preserve every behavior, flag contract, exit code and evidence path. Keep plan, gate, loop and hook commands. Atomically update plan verifiers, CI, scripts, API manifest and docs with an old-to-new invocation map; no later row may reference a removed command. Keep README's transport descriptions aligned with registered adapters. Validate all migrated invocation contracts plus representative real dispatch and record the reduced command/duplication ceilings. Avoid rerunning expensive model suites when an exact implementation-independence proof permits evidence reuse. Consolidate only shared responsibilities whose callers can migrate atomically with lower measured maintenance cost; distinct responsibilities remain separate. Command-count reduction alone is not acceptance.

items.title: Remove dependence on retired checkpoint paths with reversible relocation

steps.title: Remove dependence on retired checkpoint paths with reversible relocation
steps.rationale: After initial validation and the regression gate, relocate live checkpoints from adaptive_new under overgo/models through the existing location owner. First inventory identity, bytes, all live references and destination capacity; verify a staged destination before switching store locators. Keep the original until hash/size, recipe/servable identity, baseline lookup by content ID, bounded load/inference and rollback all pass. Do not rewrite historical evidence or delete original bytes prematurely. Regenerate current reports/fixtures, and assert every expected model remains present and no live reference requires the retired root. A successful -servable listing alone does not prove no model vanished. Remove stale locator duplication first. Move checkpoint bytes only where an active dependency on the retired location remains and relocation removes demonstrated operational cost; directory neatness alone is not a capability gain.

items.title: Prove the final text execution surface and long-lived serving behavior

steps.title: Prove the final text execution surface and long-lived serving behavior
steps.rationale: On the settled execution surface, run full-catalog text regression against the pinned before-baseline, with both framing protocols, required context/head/cache coverage and useful smoke assertions. Exercise a bounded long-lived server sequence covering concurrency, grow/shrink contexts, cancellation, failure, model reload and subsequent valid requests; assert retained VRAM plateaus within the declared budget and outputs remain correct. Reuse valid committed generation-soak evidence only with exact identity/independence proof. Publish once from a clean evidence worktree, then bind read-only identity, coverage and non-regression assertions. Also revalidate every modality/task invalidated by execution, command or location changes; compare to the initial modality report and refresh it with exact final evidence. Retain unaffected initial benchmarks; rerun only suites whose identities/behavior changed. Extend the retained longform/report checks with read-only catalog, soak and affected-modality outcome assertions through plan -setverify before closure. This milestone never gates the initial benchmark pass.

steps.title: Complete the operator-launched 27B MMLU-Pro pass
steps.rationale: Only the operator launches this full-model benchmark with -budget 3h after smaller-model validation. Estimate each protocol's cost from evidence; checkpoint/resume exact remaining cases within separate bounded launches if both protocols do not fit one budget. Preserve full coverage and input identity; do not silently truncate to fit. This row's gate reads completed evidence and never starts the expensive pass. Other host and modality preparation does not wait for this run. Dispatch contract: retain the current verifier as a lower bound, but bind executable assertions for the exact required denominator, identities, protocols, thresholds and outcomes described above before work starts. If missing, add the smallest read-only assertion to the existing owner and prove its failing counterexample before publishing evidence. A bare freshness/listing/lane command cannot close this row.

items.title: Close only after all capability and reliability branches are accounted for

steps.title: Verify the final release surface and publish evidence-bound campaign closure
steps.verify: go run ./cmd/preflight && go run ./cmd/benchmark-report -check && go run ./cmd/compatibility -check
steps.rationale: Run preflight and final host/race/device/browser/release checks appropriate to the actual final scope once, reusing only exact proven-independent evidence. Diagnose failures rather than accepting a package name without its output. Resolve high-priority findings; record explicit evidence-backed dispositions and reopen triggers for unavailable or deferred capability without calling it verified. Reconcile the census, accepted baseline, benchmark/media/capability reports and every task's terminal evidence at the closing commit; publish census authority via plan -bind-census. The gate owns pruning the final row. Acceptance asserts all required terminal branches/claims and no unresolved blocking finding, not merely plan -status. Keep the explicit operator stop in force until the operator resumes; campaign completion never clears it automatically.
